name: qw_lgw_ref
structural_change: quant_wide_ov flat cluster (38,353 flops + 20 macro clock pins on one root: ov1 crash, ov2 cancelled at 32-38k sinks with 495-727 ps CTS spread, ov3 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD) is replaced by a wires-only parent over hardened M5 leaves with their own clock roots: control head ot_hgi_qw_ovc, data head ot_hgi_qw_ovd (result SRAM + write side), 4 x read lane-group leaf ot_hgi_qw_lgr, 4 x write lane-group leaf ot_hgi_qw_lgw, the three closed decoder tiles; a register at both pins of every seam, no cycle added (gate quant_wide_ov: 184 cycles vs 168 priced = 1.095x, unchanged)

job.purpose: WQ3 quant cluster write lane-group leaf (8 lanes, hardened once, x4 on the cluster E face): die-face pin flops (wwq 2,240 out), two write quads (flat), write relays stage 2 (wy 512 b from the data head).

why_floorplan: face-anchored on the cluster's lane face: four leaves stacked at 167.76 um pitch (144.72 high + 23.04 channels, 21.6 um edge margins) on the 691.2 um face; the die-face side carries 2,192 (read) / 2,256 (write) pins on M4, so pins take every track (pin_min_tracks 1: 0.73 / 0.75 of the face tracks; 2-track slots gave PPL-0111 at 129.6 um); recipe 1 (pin flops fixed at the pins, no per-pin hold chains): the recipe-2 chains on 3,424 pins put global placement at 155 % in the 25.92 um strip, and a strip wide enough for them is < 30 % utilised by the logic
